long_biography.plain_text:
Vedat Gora founded Murat Ticaret in Istanbul in 1969 to produce automotive electrical wires and portable lamps. He expanded into wiring harnesses, battery cables and engineered assemblies, supplying vehicle and equipment manufacturers. New plants followed across Turkey, then in China, Mexico and North Macedonia, supported by overseas sales offices.

The business remained locally owned as it moved from modest production into a vertically integrated supplier serving customers in more than 25 countries. Gora's son Murat later took day-to-day leadership, marking a family succession rather than a change in the founder's role in building the platform. Volex acquired the entire company in 2023, converting five decades of industrial expansion into a major exit.
